title: Research Scholarships Round 2 (April and July 2027 intakes)
field: All research fields (higher degree by research)
about: Griffith University's Round 2 research scholarships, for April and July 2027 higher degree by research intakes, opened on 2 November 2026 and close on 5 February 2027. International applicants in this round need a qualifying research-component degree from Griffith.
requirements: International applicants: Griffith International Pathway, i.e. completed or completing an Honours, Masters or Graduate Diploma at Griffith University with a minimum 40 credit point research component in the last ten years
Domestic applicants: open merit round including the Research Training Program and the Griffith University Postgraduate Research Scholarship

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "PhD / Master of Philosophy" research study -> objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

requirement "minimum 40 credit point research component" -> objective "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps." (supports research productivity; it does not replace the eligibility requirement)

card_alt: EduCut Connect card for Research Scholarships Round 2 (April and July 2027 intakes) at Griffith University in Brisbane, Australia; application deadline 5 February 2027. The photo shows the Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge at dusk, in Sydney, not Brisbane.
